onboarding.appearanceLater: You can choose a theme later in Settings. VibeHub follows your system appearance for now.
onboarding.scanScope: Check the known installation locations for coding apps, editors, and bundled RTL components. This does not install anything, scan network ports, or contact model services.

scanStates.idle: Your computer has not been checked yet.
scanStates.error: The computer check could not finish.
scanStates.partial: Some checks could not finish. Available results are shown below.

onboarding.scanRecovery: Try the check again, or continue and use the app's troubleshooting page later.
onboarding.chooseDescription: Prepare an installed tool, or discover one to download from its official source. Optional proxy and model settings stay with the tool you choose.
onboarding.discoverHint: You can choose a tool in the catalog and follow its installation guide. No installation starts automatically.
onboarding.editorsAvailable: {{count}} other editors will also be available from My Apps.

guides.title: Guides
guides.description: Install a tool, prepare its connections, and find a useful next step.
guides.longRunningDescription: A short lesson on planning, checking results, and continuing a project.
guides.unknownRevision: Guide review date has not been recorded. Follow dates and evidence cited in the text.
guides.fallback: This guide is not available in the selected language. Showing {{language}} instead.
guides.tryAnotherSearch: Try a different word or clear the search to read the whole guide.
guides.pickAnother: Choose another tool from the list.

doctor.notRun: Run the checks to inspect local installation paths and saved settings.
doctor.summary: {{count}} checks completed. Each result only covers the check described.
doctor.copyFailure: The report could not be copied. Try again.
doctor.rtlCount: {{count}} bundled adapters available for installed tools; injection was not tested
doctor.rtlUnknown: App detection was unavailable; installed-tool RTL readiness could not be determined
doctor.proxyConfigured: Profile: {{name}}. Tool traffic was not tested.
doctor.modelsCount: {{count}} connections saved. No model request was sent.
doctor.appsFailed: Installed tools could not be read
doctor.rtlFailed: Bundled components could not be inspected

offers.syncError: The feed could not be updated. The offline catalog is still available.
offers.notificationError: System notifications are unavailable or permission was not granted.
offers.offline: Showing the saved catalog. Check the feed to look for updates.

terminal.detectionFailed: Terminal settings could not be checked.
terminal.busy: Wait for the current action to finish before starting another.
terminal.confirmInstall: The selected component will be downloaded from its official source and installed on this computer. Continue?
terminal.confirmApply: VibeHub will back up the current profile and add its own prompt configuration. You can restore the VibeHub changes later.
terminal.confirmRestore: Only VibeHub's prompt changes will be removed. Other profile customizations are kept.
terminal.actionFailed: The operation did not complete. Review the details and try again.
